mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three months signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 8.6% triggers a bearish signal, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate weakening labor market strength.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite UNRATE crossing the threshold or p-value >0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate and GDP growth (GDPC1) creates conflicting policy signals, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate market volatility.
candidate_trigger: both proxies rising in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p >0.05) or Rank IC >0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate generates stronger positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market expectations for prolonged easing intensify.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in late-cycle periods are not significantly higher than baseline (p >0.05) or Rank IC <0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 11500 Billions of Chained 2017 Dollars signals robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate market gains.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p >0.05) or Rank IC >0.03 over any 3-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 97.0 triggers bearish sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate supply-side constraints.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative (p >0.05) or Rank IC <0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE) and stagnant employment growth (PAYEMS) simultaneously signal labor market weakness, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate economic slowdown.
candidate_trigger: both proxies rising in the current month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p >0.05) or Rank IC >0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In an early expansion phase (UNRATE < 8.0%), rising employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market recovery, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate sustained growth.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p >0.05) or Rank IC <0.03 over any 12-month window.
